title: feat(embed-bridge): add installDivineEmbedBridge() for iframe-hosted Divine apps
body:
## Summary

Add a reusable embed bridge to `@divinevideo/signer` so any Divine integrated app (verifyer, badges, future first-party apps) can be hosted inside a divine.video iframe and use the host's signer over postMessage instead of asking the user to log in again.

## Motivation

divine-mobile's Flutter web build can't run the integrated-apps WebView sandbox (`webview_flutter` is mobile-only). To host first-party Divine apps from the web build, we need an iframe + postMessage NIP-07 bridge. Putting it in `divine-signer` instead of duplicating it per-app means:

- Badges adopts it with one line at startup (`installDivineEmbedBridge()`)
- Future apps using `ExtensionSigner` get embed support for free
- Single source of truth for the trust model and protocol shape

## What ships

- **`src/embed-bridge.ts`** — `installDivineEmbedBridge(opts?)` returning `true` if installed, `isDivineEmbedded()`, `getDivineParentOrigin()`, plus `EmbedBridgeOptions` / `EmbedBridgeRequest` / `EmbedBridgeResponse` types and default allowlists.
- **`src/index.ts`** — public re-exports.
- **`src/__tests__/embed-bridge.test.ts`** — 22 unit tests.
- **Version** — bumped to `1.1.0`.

## Trust model

The shim installs **only when both**:
1. `window.parent !== window` (we're framed), AND
2. `document.referrer`'s host matches the allowlist:
   - Exact: `divine.video`, `app.divine.video`, `localhost`
   - Suffix: `.divine.video`, `.pages.dev` (covers staging, POC, Cloudflare Pages previews)

`allowedHosts` and `allowedSuffixes` are overridable via options for app-specific allowlists.

Inbound `message` events are pinned to the captured parent origin. Outbound `postMessage` always uses an explicit `targetOrigin`, never `*`. Each request has a unique correlation id; replies with mismatched id or unexpected origin are ignored. A 60s timeout (overridable for tests) rejects requests if the parent is silent.

## Behavior

When installed:
- `window.nostr` is set to a postMessage-proxied NIP-07 shim — overrides any browser extension that injected one (the user is in divine.video and explicitly chose to use Divine's session).
- `window.__divineEmbedded = true`
- `window.__divineParentOrigin = '<host origin>'`

Top-level (non-framed) loads are unaffected — the function returns `false` and apps' existing extension / OAuth / NIP-46-bunker login paths continue to work for direct visits.

Idempotent: calling twice is a no-op on the second call.

## Test plan

- [x] `npm test` — 90 tests pass (22 new for embed-bridge, 68 existing)
- [x] `npm run build` — bundles cleanly, `dist/index.js` 17.7kb
- [ ] Consumed by verifyer.divine.video (replaces inline copy from divinevideo/divine-identify-verification-service#10)
- [ ] Consumed by badges.divine.video (new adoption)
- [ ] End-to-end with divine-mobile Flutter web parent listener (in flight)

title: refactor: use @divinevideo/login for OAuth/RPC layer
body:
## Summary

Replaces divine-signer's own OAuth/RPC implementation with `@divinevideo/login`'s `DivineRpc`, eliminating duplicated code between the two libraries.

## Blocked on

> **Do not merge** until [divinevideo/divine-login#1](https://github.com/divinevideo/divine-login/pull/1) is merged and `@divinevideo/login@1.1.0` is published to npm. The devDependency currently uses `file:../divine-login` for local development — swap to `^1.1.0` before merging.

## Changes

- **`src/oauth-signer.ts`** — Rewritten as thin adapter wrapping `DivineRpc`. `OAuthSigner` class API is unchanged. Internally delegates getPublicKey, signEvent, encrypt/decrypt to DivineRpc. Token refresh stays in OAuthSigner (DivineRpc's `onUnauthorized` hook delegates to it).
- **`src/oauth.ts`** — Replaced with re-exports from `@divinevideo/login` (`DivineOAuth`, `createDivineClient`, `generatePkce`, types).
- **`src/__tests__/oauth.test.ts`** — Deleted (PKCE/OAuth tests now live in divine-login).
- **`src/index.ts`** — Updated exports: adds `DivineOAuth`, `createDivineClient`, `generatePkce`; removes `buildOAuthUrl`, `exchangeCode`, `OAuthStorage`, `OAuthConfig`.
- **`package.json`** — New peer dep `@divinevideo/login >= 1.1.0`, esbuild `--external:@divinevideo/login`.

## Breaking changes

- **Removed:** `buildOAuthUrl`, `exchangeCode`, `OAuthStorage`, `OAuthConfig` exports
- **Added:** `DivineOAuth`, `createDivineClient`, `generatePkce`, `DivineClientConfig`, `DivineStorage` exports  
- **New peer dep:** `@divinevideo/login >= 1.1.0`
- **`OAuthSigner`** class API unchanged
- **`OAuthError`** class unchanged (same name, message format, `.status`)

## Before merge checklist

- [ ] divine-login PR #1 merged
- [ ] `@divinevideo/login@1.1.0` published to npm
- [ ] Swap devDependency from `file:../divine-login` to `^1.1.0`
- [ ] Bump version to 0.5.0
